<function name="Height" parent="PropSelect" type="panelfield">
	<description>
If set to above 0, automatically stretches the panel to fit this many rows. Default is 2.

If 0 or below, it will automatically stretch to fit all rows.
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
<rets>
<ret type="number">The amount of rows to stretch to.</ret>
</rets>
</function>
